text_block_list.text: The day of the Mile Championship—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ――Ah.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Flight-san, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Bakushin O-chan.

"That fateful morning began with a very 
peaceful, everyday greeting."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Are you heading out now too, Flight-san? 
Then by all means, let's go together!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes. Isn't that wonderful, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
We've still got time, so go ahead and take 
the long way around.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ! ...Yes, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ngh? Ngh ngh ngh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Did we really need to split up? We're 
definitely going to catch up to them 
anyway!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I wonder. I'm sure you won't be able 
to catch up today――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A detour, though...? Even though the 
racecourse is right in front of us.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I feel, like... all itchy and restless—!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —Bakushin O-chan, I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I only left you alone for a brief moment. 
More than enough time for you to race on 
through.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not entirely sure what's going on, 
but everything's fine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Because Flight-san is right by my side 
right now!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Yes!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Then, could I say... something even more 
confusing?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead! As class rep, I will make sure I 
understand!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Your very presence is woven right into 
my coordination."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it's the same for you. That's why 
we'll be able to reach an even greater 
radiance.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "...I understand what you are saying."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words—we are absolutely wonderful 
rivals!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...So that's what it means!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yup.

"While waiting for North Flight and the 
others at the still-empty racetrack—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chowaaah!? Trainer-san did it first! Why!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nunu... If it's come to this, Trainer, you 
enter the race too! Let's see which of us 
is faster!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, no! It's actually fine after all! 
I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Because I have Flight-san with me! —Now 
then, see you on the turf!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes!
choice_data_list:
Looks like you two were able to chat a 
lot.

It seems like you had plenty to talk 
about!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes, plenty. With this—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: You can wear it. The finest radiance.

—As post time drew near, Kyoto Racecourse 
overflowed with fans eager to witness the 
hottest rivalry showdown of the season.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Woah, what a crowd...! I guess everyone's 
here to see the showdown between Bakushin 
O and Flight?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think so? Thanks to the two of 
them, the sprint division's been super 
exciting lately!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Watching up to this point, Flight seems to 
have the edge in the Mile... but Bakushin 
O has been evolving lately too, so I can't 
wait to see!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—What will happen when these two storms 
collide, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san's fragrant breeze, Bakushin 
O-san's radiant breeze... The one I know 
better is the fragrance.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Which one will you... wrap yourself in? Or 
perhaps...—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...First, let us bear witness. To where 
these raging winds will carry them—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Biko-san! Hello there!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hellooo! ...Wait, no!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's hyped up about the showdown 
between the senpais... but I'm running in 
this race, too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to introduce myself as well! As a 
lone hero!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm, that's the spirit! As class rep, 
I shall lend you my aid!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However! The battle between Flight and 
me... is going to be fierce.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
—Come at me! With all the speed you 
possess!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!! Yes!

Surrounded by a whirlwind of hopes and 
expectations... North Flight had quietly 
finished her preparations.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind... doing a fashion check on 
my outfit today?

At her urging, I take a few steps back and 
look over North Flight's full outfit—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?

North Flight is always stylish. Even so... 
dressed in the best outfit that truly 
suits her today, she is more dazzling than 
ever—
choice_data_list:
You, as you are today, are the most 
"lovely" of all

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "...―― Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I think the me of today... is definitely 
the me I love the most, too.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I'm heading out, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In an outfit that's my absolute favorite, 
cool, wonderful... and just perfect for 
me!

Light and free, her hair bounces. Clad in 
her favorite fashion, she takes flight 
now—toward the place she loves most.
